purpose: Recurring formats. A series repeats one recipe on a fixed cadence so viewers know what to come back for and so learning compares like with like. Status 'proposed' series are suggestions; the owner activates them.

series.name: Hidden Gem of the Week
series.promise: One great game that is not new, and the single reason it still deserves your time.

series.name: The Amiga Corner
series.promise: One Amiga moment explained through what the player actually did.

series.name: Handheld Reality Check
series.promise: What a handheld really does with one game, recorded and sourced.

series.name: Local AI Fit Test
series.promise: Does this local model fit this machine and this task? Measured, not promised.

series.name: The Fair Task Duel
series.promise: Two tools, one identical task, recorded start to finish.
